title: Paul McCartney live: Desert Trip festival | 2016
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Desert Trip festival at the Indio Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, USA, on 8 October 2016.

It was the 38th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between September and November 2005.

Desert Trip was a music festival taking place from 7-9 and 14-16 October 2016. Other performers included Bob Dylan, The Rolling Stones, Neil Young, Roger Waters, and The Who. McCartney performed there again on 15 October.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

During the set McCartney was joined on stage by Neil Young for performances of ‘A Day In The Life’, ‘Give Peace A Chance’, and ‘Why Don’t We Do It In The Road?’.
